current_date: List approved November 2022, last updated July 2023
current_evidence: The V12 Validation Checklist fetched from the same path (without the ?ver cache parameter) states 'List Approved November 2022 - last updated July 2023'; searches of waverley.gov.uk returned only V12 and the older V8, with no later version found. The planning landing page could not be fetched because the shared WebFetch budget ran out, so this was not confirmed from the page that links it.

issues.detail: Many numbered local requirements in V12 are missing from both the tab and the app-type rows: 5g Street Scene Elevation (infill/replacement dwellings and extensions raising the ridgeline where there are immediate neighbours, unless 20m+ apart); 12 Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (where light to adjoining properties could be harmed); 13 Housing Space Standards Statement (all new housing); 15 Extensions to Dwellings in the Green Belt (Green Belt extensions outside settlement boundaries, with % floor area increase since 31 Dec 1968); 16 Affordable Housing Statement (net 6+ dwellings in designated rural areas, 11+ elsewhere, or >1,000 sqm); 17 Land Contamination Assessment; 18 Air Quality Assessment (in or next to an AQMA, or CHP/biomass); 25 Statement of Community Involvement (10+ dwellings, 1,000 sqm+, or sites over 1 ha); 27 Open Space Assessment; 28 Infrastructure Statement (major applications); 30 Town Centre Uses (main town centre uses outside centres, 1,000 sqm+); 31a Rural Workers' Dwelling assessment; 31b Agricultural Land assessment (loss of best and most versatile land); 32 Marketing Viability Appraisal (Council proforma, 9+ months marketing); 33 Financial Appraisal (policy exceptions on viability grounds); 38 Energy Statement (new buildings, SAP DER vs TER).

The Householder rows leave out householder-specific local items in V12: the Biodiversity Checklist (required for most applications including householder), CIL Form 1 (all applications), Street Scene Elevation for extensions that raise the ridgeline, Extensions to Dwellings in the Green Belt, and SuDS (householders must show drainage changes on plans).
issues.evidence: Item 2 CIL Form 1 'required for all applications irrespective of CIL liability'; item 4 Biodiversity Checklist exceptions list does not include householder; item 15 Green Belt extensions

issues.detail: Grokbot read the X-matrix column headers as if they were triggers. Transport Assessment is placed under Householder, Listed building consent, Lawful development cert, Prior approval, s73 and Discharge of conditions, and Flood Risk Assessment under Listed building consent, Lawful development cert, Prior approval and Discharge of conditions. In each case the reason given is 'Application type named in requirement text', but the 'names' are just the column headings of the matrix ('...Householder Application Legend X X X 35.'). Tree Survey was put under Listed building consent from the matrix legend text ('X – Mandatory Listed Building Consent X – Possibly required').
issues.evidence: trigger_excerpt 'Transport Assessment Certificate of Lawfulness Section 191 (existing) ** Discharge of Condition X X – Possibly required ... Householder Application Legend X X X 35.'

issues.detail: Questions from the Climate Change and Sustainability Checklist (householder/advert/minor shopfront version) were turned into separate requirements under Householder and Advertisement consent: 'Electric vehicle charging details', 'Lighting Assessment', 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' and 'Water efficiency statement'. In V12 these are checklist questions, not standalone documents. The real Ventilation/Extraction Statement (item 29) applies to significant retail, business, industrial and leisure uses (E(b), A4, A5, E(g), B2), never to householder or advertisement applications.
issues.evidence: Householder 'Ventilation' trigger: 'First measures Ventilation systems are energy efficient and adequate to the size and function of a room.'; V12 item 29 Ventilation/Extraction Statement trigger

issues.detail: Many requirements are placed only under Full planning with the 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' note, even though the source applies them more widely. Examples: CIL Form 1 is required for all applications; the Biodiversity Checklist is required for most types; the full Climate Change and Sustainability Checklist also covers outline, reserved matters and technical details consent. Tree Survey and Arboricultural Implications is missing from Full planning and Outline altogether.
issues.evidence: Item 36: full checklist 'required for full, outline, reserved matters and technical details consent applications'; CIL row trigger 'Required for all applications irrespective of CIL liability' but placed only under Full planning

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are garbled matrix text or fragments that do not say when the item applies. The Flood Risk Assessment and Transport Assessment excerpts are runs of column headers and X marks; Fire Statement leaves out the threshold (two or more dwellings or educational accommodation in buildings of 18m+ or 7+ storeys); Parking is just 'and proposed parking provision.'; Photographs is a size rule ('no larger in size than 15cm X 10 cm'); Energy Statement and Sustainability checklist under Full planning are cut off at 'Change and Sustainability Checklist.'
issues.evidence: FRA trigger ends '...Demolition in Conservation area You can sele'

issues.detail: Several tab items are process text or form fragments rather than requirements: the GDPR redaction guidance, the 'Acceptable file types and sizes for submission via Planning Portal' heading, 'Please answer ALL questions YES or NO by marking the appropriate box...' (an instruction on the Biodiversity Checklist form), and 'Additional dwellings in the Thames Basin Heaths SPA and Hindhead Together Concept Strategy Area.', which is a bare heading with no requirement attached.

'No single file size to exceed 10Mb.' and 'No single file size to exceed 10 Mb.' are listed as two separate submission rules. 'Validation checklist form (completed)' under Full planning repeats the Biodiversity Checklist row word for word.
issues.evidence: tab_items Submission rules rows 8 and 10; app_type Full planning 'Validation checklist form (completed)' trigger = Biodiversity Checklist text

issues.detail: Grokbot reports 29 requirement items, but the tab holds only 14 items and most are submission rules. V12 numbers 38+ items (with sub-items such as 5g, 6b, 31a/31b), so the capture is far from complete. Note too that Waverley is abolished on 1 April 2027 and a West Surrey Council list is expected after that.

summary: Grokbot's V12 link (approved Nov 2022, updated July 2023) still appears to be Waverley's current validation checklist, but the capture is very incomplete: at least 16 numbered local requirements are missing, and app-type placement is unreliable because the X-matrix headers were read as triggers and Climate Change checklist questions were treated as standalone requirements.
